verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no first-party documentation of scoped or tenant tokens, document-level security, or per-user search restriction within a shared index. Community comments only mention a paid 'fine-grained access control' add-on in passing and an nginx reverse-proxy workaround. Neither shows the product delivering per-end-user document scoping.

support.subject: As a developer, scoped or tenant tokens restrict each end user's searches to their own documents without separate indexes per user
